title: $289,140 a Year to Straighten Teeth
description:
Orthodontists make 289,140 dollars a year. That's the median.

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Orthodontists 29-1023, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029102313
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Orthodontists, 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029102311
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Orthodontists, 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029102315
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Orthodontists, employment: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029102301
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Dentists, general 29-1021, annual median wage: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000029102113
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Airline pilots 53-2011, annual median wage: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000053201113

From the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025 (api.bls.gov): orthodontists' annual median wage $289,140, 10th percentile $99,850, 90th percentile $416,000, employment 6,210; general dentists' median $170,950; airline pilots' median $232,140. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Orthodontists make about 289,000 dollars a year. That's the median.
That's more than airline pilots. And way more than dentists.
The top ten percent? Around 416,000 dollars a year.
Even the lowest paid earn almost 100,000 dollars.
But it's a tiny club. Only about 6,200 in the whole country.
